messages:
ana: quick design sync on API Keys list. two main things: long scope lists blow out row height, and the reveal flow needs clearer affordances on mobile. attaching mini-mock: https://figma.com/file/mini
leo: for scopes I propose a compressed single-line summary: '3 scopes 3 more' with a disclosure that opens a focusable popup. chips are nice but heavy for >6.
sam: agree re: popup. implementation note: make chips aria-hidden and expose an offscreen summary like 'Scopes: read, write, deploy' on the row for screen readers.
nora: accessibility nit: the reveal action must announce via aria-live and require a short confirmation if the session auth is stale (>15m). also use aria-label 'Reveal API key. Visible for 30 seconds.'
ana: small copy change for create modal: replace 'This key will be shown once' with 'This key will be revealed only once. Save it now; you won't be able to view it again.'
leo: post-create UI: show an expiry pill (e.g., 'expires in 1h') inline so ephemeral keys aren't lost in a toast. allow pinning reminders as optional.
sam: mobile actions: keep Copy as a visible ghost button, collapse others into kebab. ensure touch targets >= 44px and avoid swipe-to-delete.
nora: revoke flow: add optional reason radio + freeform note. show a tiny privacy hint: 'Notes visible to org admins only.' audit log will store reason and note.
nana: checklist: 1) add compressed-summary variant to figma, 2) update modal copy, 3) spec aria-live strings and stale-auth confirm, 4) add expiry pill mock, 5) include revoke reason mock. I'll file acceptance criteria after this thread.
ops-bot: heads-up: feature-flag keys_ui_compact will gate rollout to 20% on staging on 2026-04-08. include accessibility review before ship.
leo: thanks, will push the figma updates and annotate keyboard behavior. :thumbsup:
